name: Tapachula

queries.query: Tapachula Chiapas municipal cadastre parcel map official GIS
queries.result: Official municipal Treasury cadastral-tax lookup and official Chiapas GeoWeb/GeoServer were found. No first-party public city parcel viewer was verified.

queries.query: catastro municipal Tapachula Chiapas mapa predial sitio oficial
queries.result: The official municipal result identifies Dirección de Catastro Municipal and a public clave catastral/cuenta lookup. Official state map and GeoWeb results provide general cartography and WMS/WFS infrastructure, not a confirmed urban cadastral parcel layer.

registryBasis: Tapachula's official municipal Treasury identifies the Dirección de Catastro Municipal and provides a public lookup by clave catastral or cuenta única; this establishes a local cadastral custodian/service, but not public parcel geometry access.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: H. Ayuntamiento de Tapachula, Tesorería Municipal / Dirección de Catastro Municipal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public page states lookup by clave catastral or cuenta única and names the municipal cadastral directorate. It is an attribute/payment workflow, not a safe geometry API. Direct request timed out in this environment.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Gobierno del Estado de Chiapas / CEIEG
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Public JavaScript/configuration was reachable and exposes map layers; listed layers include urban blocks, settlements and a generic parcelas layer, but no verified Tapachula urban cadastral coverage.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Gobierno del Estado de Chiapas / state geospatial service
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Anonymous GetCapabilities succeeded. Catalog includes parcelas and ran_zonaparcelafeb2025; the catalog itself does not establish that either layer is a municipal urban cadastre.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: No response body obtained from the municipal Treasury host in this environment. Search-indexed official page confirms municipal cadastral contact/context.
No response body obtained; no account lookup was attempted and no personal/property attributes were requested.
Official viewer HTML and JavaScript references retrieved; no credentials or bypasses used.
Official GeoServer capabilities retrieved; CRS/layer metadata inspected.
Bounded anonymous request returned a valid empty FeatureCollection (0 features). This is not evidence of citywide absence.

Returned one MultiPolygon with safe fields nuc_poligo, zpar_zona, edo_clv, mun_clv, nuc_clv and programa. The returned geometry was outside the requested urban target extent and was not retained as a city sample.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Statewide Chiapas thematic GIS and published parcel/RAN layers plus Tapachula municipal cadastral-tax lookup.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous GeoServer access and one bounded query response; no verified urban Tapachula parcel geometry.

nativeFieldMapping.parcelLayer: parcelas: native schema not exposed in returned empty response
nativeFieldMapping.ranLayer: nuc_poligo is the apparent native polygon key; other returned fields are source attributes and are not retained in a sample

remainingUncertainty: The municipal service may have cadastral records behind its account workflow, but its map/API contract and urban parcel geometry coverage were not publicly verified. A zero bounded response from parcelas cannot establish absence.
nextStep: Retry the municipal service when reachable and inspect only its public bootstrap/configuration for a documented geometry endpoint; if a safe urban parcel layer is confirmed, request a small bbox around the fixed WUP point and independently validate native identity and CRS before adapter qualification.
